strings.Viewer.RememberConnectionsTip: Only stores IP addresses and ports of authorized connections.
strings.Viewer.GpuRenderingTip: Automatically falls back to compatibility mode when GPU rendering is unavailable.
strings.Viewer.KeepConnectedOnTopologyTip: Requires a newer Host. Uncheck when connecting to an older Host.
strings.Viewer.ClipboardImageTip: Two-way synchronization, up to 8 MiB or 16 MP.
strings.Viewer.FileClipboardTip: Copy and paste files between both computers.
strings.Viewer.AutomaticQualityTip: Adjust frame rate and bitrate within the limits above.
strings.Viewer.StatusCapabilityRevoked: Session capability was disabled; re-enabling requires reconnecting and re-authorizing.
